title: Consumer prices rose 0.6% in September, putting annual inflation rate at 3.7%
summary: CNBC live read of the September 2026 CPI: 3.7% headline, core up to 2.6%, gasoline leading, housing re-accelerating, rate-hike odds jump, and why the three-month annualized rate is a poor policy guide.

verdicts.note: One 0.6% month moved the three-month annualized rate from about 2% to 3.3%, showing how noisy the measure is.

Shifting the window by one month moves the three-month annualized CPI rate from about 0.2% (June-August 2026, after June's -0.4%) to about 4.6% (July-September 2026), demonstrating the volatility; whether that makes it unfit to guide policy is a judgment the data do not settle.
